Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: One operational staff was observed texting a family member during the inspection.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: The caregiver in the Pre-K classroom was on their cell phone while children were sleeping during naptime.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: A caregiver was on her phone while responsible for a group of children in care.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: It was found that a caregiver was using a cellphone while supervising children in care
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: Inspector observed one caregiver on their cell phone while children were napping.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: The caregiver of the school-age group had a cell-phone and computer out while the children in care were playing. The caregiver was not able to properly and sufficiently supervise children in their care while conducting reports on their personal computer.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: During the inspection I observed a caregiver in the infant room texting, this text was not related to the care of children.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: One caregiver observed in the afterschool classroom with the Toddler age group was observed utilizing her cell phone. The caregiver was not aware that she was in charge of the group during naptime.   The caregiver was informed immediately by the Director that she was responsible for the age group, and that cell phone use is prohibited.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: Caregiver used her cell phone while caring for children. The cell phone usage was non related to assigned work duties.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: Based on information obtained during the investigation, it has been determined that staff are cleaning their classrooms at the end of the day while still supervising children.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: There is sufficient evidence to suggest that a caregiver was performing janitorial duties with children in care.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: Based on the information gathered, a caregiver used their personal cell phone to record a child's behavior in the classroom, as per the director's request.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver was conducting janitorial duties while caring for a group of children.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: During the course of this investigation, it was determined two caregivers were using their cellphones while caring for school age children.
